Adaptive strategy stops early when encountering saturation (duplicate content)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { crawlStrategy: "best_first", maxConcurrent: 1, maxDepth: 2, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
